name: BSP_LuaBinding_SetShipSpeed
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_commanded_speed, read-only analysis. __fastcall(lua_State), body 00890D30-00890EEE. The Lua binding luaMW_SetShipSpeed (its own error string at 00890D30). Resolves argument 0 to a unit through BSP_ObjectHandle_FromLuaTable, takes argument 1 as a number, and stores the pair on the navigator parameter block at *(unit+73Ch): 00890E86 writes +24h = max(speed, 0) (the FLDZ/FCOMPI/JBE clamp at 00890E73) and 00890E97 writes +28h = the mission clock DAT_00F876A4. One of the two producers docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md left contract: unread. docs/UNIT_COMMANDED_SPEED.md

evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_entity_think_dispatch, read-only analysis; docs/ENTITY_THINK_DISPATCH.md, partial coverage. name: BSP_Game_PlayNamedMovie
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall, RET at 0089a47c. Concatenates the literal 'movies/' onto the script's movie name and calls 004cd390 with the goToDebrief flag; also reaches 004d7970. Sole caller 0089a480. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md. | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2g (reports/game_executable_milestone_2g.json): the CALL 004cd390 is at 0089a40e and the CALL 004d7970 at 0089a469, guarded by TEST BL,BL at 0089a45c, so a script PlayBinkMovie(name, true) issued in game state 0Dh reaches EndScene synchronously and EndScene enqueues state request 10h; the poll 004d7ea0 then never runs, because its first test wants an empty request queue. Observed in local/game_run_2g.log: the poll ran on 90 in-mission frames and read game+7188h on 89.

name: BSP_LuaGame_PlayBinkMovie
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Lua binding registered at 00e0ba60 as {00d10b84 'PlayBinkMovie', 0089a480}. __fastcall(LuaState*) -> int, RET at 0089a658. Its second argument becomes result+21h, the byte 004d7ea0 reads to decide whether the movie ends the mission. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md. | Packet cc_exe_2g: the debrief flag is the THIRD Lua argument and defaults to false. 0089a5a2 XOR BL,BL, 0089a5a4 CALL 00b663f0 (argument count), 0089a5a9 CMP EAX,3 / JL 0089a5e0, 0089a5ae reads argument index 2 as a boolean into BL, 0089a5e0 MOV DL,BL then 0089a5e6 CALL 0089a390. Installed scripts match: Scripts/global/commandhelpers.lua calls PlayBinkMovie(Mission.MissionComplParams.Movie, empty string, true) for the end of a mission and a one-argument PlayBinkMovie(campaigns/BSM/m0102.bik) for a mid-mission clip, which therefore never ends a mission.
